prompt: Explain the difference between an array and a linked list. Give one situation where each is the better choice.
model_answer: Array: contiguous, O(1) index access, fixed/costly resize. Linked list: nodes with pointers, O(1) insert/delete at known position, O(n) access. Array for random access; linked list for frequent insertions.
